grammar: The core is EASM; a rail is a system (or the channel to the person); orange light inside a rail is information moving (out of the core: EASM reaching out; in: something arriving). A docked rail is in use. The core turning is thinking, glowing is EASM’s voice only, empty is no connection.
reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion or data-easm-motion="off" on any ancestor: the still picture of each state
replay: One-shots (done, error) play once and rest on the still mark; change replayKey (React) or call replay() to play again
rule: Switch state when the real event happens, never on a timer; pair every working state with text that names the work.

icon.name: idle
icon.label: EASM
icon.motion: The still mark. The engine stops.

icon.name: connecting
icon.label: EASM is connecting
icon.use: A voice call, kiosk or chat session is opening
icon.motion: The rails plug into the core one by one, clockwise, while the core’s empty centre swells and settles.

icon.name: listening
icon.label: EASM is listening
icon.use: The microphone is open (pass the MediaStream as level)
icon.motion: The user’s voice pours in along their rail (left) from its tip toward the core, as far as it is loud. The core never glows.

icon.name: thinking
icon.label: EASM is thinking
icon.use: The model is reasoning, before any tool or search
icon.motion: The core turns without stopping, quickening and easing on each quarter; each corner brushes the rail it passes.

icon.name: searching
icon.label: EASM is searching
icon.use: Retrieval: knowledge base, documents, policies, catalogue
icon.motion: A sweep: each rail in turn sends light out of the core to its tip and reaches out with it.

icon.name: toolCalling
icon.label: EASM is using a connected system
icon.use: An integration is called (SIS, CRM, ERP, LMS, PBX…)
icon.motion: A system’s rail docks; the request fills it; it holds; the reply drains back into the core, which takes it in. A different system each call.

icon.name: writing
icon.label: EASM is writing
icon.use: A text answer is streaming into the chat
icon.motion: Strokes of light leave the core along the answer rail (right) at the uneven cadence of writing.

icon.name: speaking
icon.label: EASM is speaking
icon.use: EASM’s speech is playing (pass the audio as level)
icon.motion: The core glows with the real voice; the voice runs out along the answer rail as far as it is loud.

icon.name: awaiting
icon.label: EASM is waiting for you
icon.use: EASM has asked for a confirmation, a choice or a missing detail
icon.motion: The user’s rail stays lit and the whole mark breathes slowly: over to you.

icon.name: done
icon.label: Done
icon.motion: Plays once: light fills every rail round the circle, drains into the core, one beat, then the still mark.

icon.name: error
icon.label: EASM could not complete this
icon.use: A task failed or a system did not answer
icon.motion: Plays once: a request falls back halfway, its rail comes away, the core empties and fills again, then the still mark.

icon.name: offline
icon.label: EASM is offline
icon.use: There is no connection to EASM
icon.motion: Still: the core is empty and the rails fall back.

waveform.name: idle
waveform.label: Voice
waveform.use: The voice channel exists but nothing is moving (mic closed, nothing playing)

waveform.name: loading
waveform.label: Loading
waveform.use: A voice session or audio is being prepared
waveform.motion: One crest crosses the dots left to right, each swelling into a short pill as it passes; then the row rests.

waveform.name: listening
waveform.label: Listening
waveform.use: The microphone is open (pass the MediaStream as level)
waveform.motion: The user’s voice, tallest in the middle and rippling outward; in silence the dots breathe.

waveform.name: speaking
waveform.label: EASM is speaking
waveform.use: EASM’s speech is playing (pass the audio as level)
waveform.motion: EASM’s voice in the same shape; without a level, the EASM voice’s own rhythm.

dots.name: typing
dots.label: EASM is writing
dots.motion: A wave runs left to right: each dot rises and swells in turn, then all rest.

dots.name: searching
dots.label: EASM is searching
dots.motion: A highlight scans 1 → 2 → 3 → 2 → 1, lingering at the ends as it turns.

dots.name: thinking
dots.label: EASM is thinking
dots.motion: Slow swells, one dot after another; nothing moves position.
